concept: A fractured, burning cityscape viewed through a kaleidoscopic prism, with flames consuming buildings in the background while a massive crowd silhouette presses forward in the foreground, their raised fists blurred and multiplied by refraction. The composition splits between chaos and containment—fire, water cannons, smoke, and bodies compressed into bold angular blocks of red, black, and gray. Style: expressionist, high contrast, dystopian.
explanation: Today's headlines overwhelmingly depict violence, suffering, and systemic failures across multiple continents—mass protests erupting into riots and looting in France, drug epidemics decimating communities, fatal crushes at public events, poisoned children, military base tragedy, and clashes from the West Bank to Albania. While there are moments of minor grace (the Pope's recovery, the rare diamond's exhibition), they are vastly outweighed by the scale of human suffering and social breakdown. The fractured prism and multiplied crowd represent how these crises fragment societies and overwhelm institutions designed to protect people.

headlines.title: Violent clashes, looting and buildings ablaze in France as over 1,200 arrested after protests
headlines.summary: Disorder broke out in cities across the country on a day in which more than half a million joined cost of living protests.

headlines.title: A wave of homemade, synthetic drugs sweeps US and deepens crisis
headlines.summary: BBC News hears from users, dealers, prison and recovery workers as the country battles with a deadly new drug epidemic.

headlines.title: European diplomats attacked by Israeli settlers in West Bank
headlines.summary: The Israeli military condemns the violence but the prime minister's office says it is part of a "smear" campaign.

headlines.title: Deaths confirmed in major fire at Canada military base
headlines.summary: Number of casualties unknown in "very, very active and delicate" situation in Alberta, says defence minister.

headlines.title: Anti-government protesters battle with police in Albania
headlines.summary: There were violent clashes between demonstrators and riot police throughout Saturday in the capital Tirana.

headlines.title: Photos show luxury boat with 50m pool and water slides near Kim Jong Un's summer retreat
headlines.summary: Satellite images give clues about how Kim spends his holidays - something far out of reach for most North Koreans.

headlines.title: At least 17 dead in crush at Hindu festival event in India
headlines.summary: Many more have been injured at an event in the Indian city of Kolkata to mark a Hindu festival.

headlines.title: Nursery owner in China jailed for life after hundreds of children poisoned
headlines.summary: She and five staff members were found to have used the inedible paint in meals to make them look more appealing.

headlines.title: Rare pink diamond goes on display in France 100 years after amateur heist
headlines.summary: The French royal jewel will be on public display for the first time since it was found hidden in an apple after a 1926 theft.

headlines.title: Pope discharged from hospital days after lung cancer surgery
headlines.summary: The pontiff will give the traditional Angelus prayer and blessing in St Peter's Square on Sunday.

headlines.title: Actress Selma Blair says she 'did not intend to harm anyone' in plane altercation
headlines.summary: A publicist for the actress said the incident stemmed from a "medical emergency" and said she has a neurological disorder that can cause out-of-control responses.

headlines.title: Judge throws out child sex abuse charges against actor Timothy Busfield
headlines.summary: The judge in the case said on Friday that the prosecutor "failed to act in a fair and impartial manner".
